'''Cyrstas Eloinie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who was the daughter of [[Darred Eloinie]], the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of the armaments firm [[Eloinie Petro-Munitions]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Cyrstas attended the [[Peaceful Dawn Rally]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaraksander]] to protest on the side of the [[Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites]], but during the event she was kidnapped by the NFP, who were unaware that she was a supporter of their cause. The NFP then took Eloinie into the [[Fioer desert]] and demanded that her father pay a ransom of 100,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for her return. In response, Darred Eloinie hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Valken Gresh]] to rescue his daughter.
